name: zsh-wordsplit-guard
description: Denies a Bash command containing `for x in $var`: the Bash tool runs zsh, where parameter expansion is not word-split, so the loop silently runs once over the whole string instead of per element. Names the fixes (`${=var}`, `${(f)var}`, an array plus `"${a[@]}"`, a literal list). Opt out per call with `[nosplit]` in the description, or session-wide with ALLOW_ZSH_NOSPLIT=1.
